paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя разпределението на характери в RoleplayPref, организирано в три основни категории — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters и Real Characters — с 13 подкатегории, изобразени във външния пръстен. Централният син сектор, означаващ Virtual Characters, заема най-голямата част от диаграмата, приблизително 60%, и е разделен на пет подкатегории: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters и Game Characters, всички изобразени с еднакъв светлосин цвят; визуално Movie Characters изглежда като най-голямата подкатегория в този сектор. Следващият сектор, Custom Characters, е изобразен с розов цвят и заема малък дял от диаграмата, без изрично обозначени подкатегории. Третият сектор, Real Characters, е в зелен цвят и също заема по-малък дял от диаграмата, разделен на седем подкатегории: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors и Influencers, всички с еднакъв светлозелен цвят; визуално Musicians изглежда като най-голямата подкатегория в този сектор. Диаграмата не включва легенда, а процентните стойности не са изписани вътре в секторите; подкатегориите са етикетирани с текст, разположен външно от пръстена. Секторите в централната част са подредени по низходящ ред на големина — от най-голямия (Virtual Characters) към най-малкия (Custom Characters), а външният пръстен показва подкатегориите във визуално последователен ред, без явно подчертаване на някой от тях.
model_annotations.English: The pie chart illustrates the character distribution in RoleplayPref, categorized into three main groups: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters, with 13 subcategories displayed in the outer ring. Virtual Characters, represented by a large light blue segment, constitute approximately 60% of the total distribution and are further divided into five subcategories: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters. Among these, Movie Characters appear to be the largest subcategory within Virtual Characters. Real Characters, shown in green, make up a smaller portion and are subdivided into seven subcategories: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians being the most prominent within this group. Custom Characters, depicted in pink, occupy a small segment with no further subcategories labeled. The chart features a central circle highlighting the three primary categories, while the outer ring displays the subcategories with corresponding labels. Percentage values are not explicitly marked on the slices, but the relative sizes suggest the proportions described. The visual layout emphasizes the dominance of Virtual Characters, followed by Real Characters, with Custom Characters forming the smallest portion.
model_annotations.German: Das Kreisdiagramm zeigt die Charakterverteilung in RoleplayPref, die in drei Hauptkategorien unterteilt ist: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters und Real Characters, wobei die 13 Untergruppen im äußeren Ring dargestellt sind. Virtual Characters nehmen etwa 60 % des Diagramms ein und sind in fünf Untergruppen unterteilt: Comic Characters (hellblau), Movie Characters (hellblau), Teleplay Characters (hellblau), Novel Characters (hellblau) und Game Characters (hellblau), wobei Movie Characters den größten Anteil innerhalb dieser Kategorie darstellen. Real Characters umfassen sieben Untergruppen – Scientists (hellgrün), Artists (hellgrün), Athletes (hellgrün), Writers (hellgrün), Musicians (hellgrün), Actors (hellgrün) und Influencers (hellgrün) – wobei Musicians den größten Anteil innerhalb dieser Kategorie einnehmen. Custom Characters sind als kleiner, rosa Segment dargestellt und weisen keine beschrifteten Untergruppen auf. Die Segmente sind im äußeren Ring nach absteigender Größe angeordnet, wobei die größten Segmente links oben beginnen und im Uhrzeigersinn verlaufen. Das Diagramm enthält keine Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente, aber die relative Größe der Segmente ist deutlich erkennbar. Die Hauptkategorien sind im zentralen Kreis positioniert, wobei Virtual Characters den größten zentralen Bereich einnehmen, gefolgt von Real Characters und einem kleinen Segment für Custom Characters.
